ios.desc:
Minimo Travel Kit is the ultimate all-in-one travel companion designed specifically to work 100% offline. Whether you are deep in the mountains, navigating a foreign city without a SIM card, or just avoiding expensive roaming charges, Minimo Travel Kit ensures you have all the essential tools right in your pocket without sacrificing your privacy.
Powered by cutting-edge on-device AI, Minimo Travel Kit processes everything locally on your iPhone. No cloud, no tracking, no data leaks.

KEY FEATURES:
Offline AI Translator & Camera Scan Instantly translate text, menus, and signs using your camera or photo library. Our on-device AI handles complex translations across multiple languages instantly, without needing a single drop of Wi-Fi.
Universal Currency & Unit Converter Convert local prices, distances, weights, temperatures, speeds, and areas instantly. Perfect for negotiating at markets or understanding local speed limits.
Anchor Compass Never get lost again. Drop an anchor at your hotel or parking spot, and our map-free compass will guide you straight back using only GPS hardware—no data connection required.
Travel Wallet & Budget Tracker Keep your trip finances in check. Log cash expenses and track your budget completely offline.
Secure Document Vault Store copies of your passport, visas, and boarding passes behind Face ID / Touch ID protection.
Safety Alarm & Softbox Light Stay safe with a one-tap 110 dB personal siren for emergencies, and use the Softbox Light to illuminate your path or get the perfect warm key light for evening photos.
 vCard Importer Met someone new? Instantly scan their business card or QR code (from your camera or photos) and save their contact details straight to your phone.
Itinerary Builder Organize your flights, hotels, and daily plans cleanly in one place.

PRIVACY FIRST (Air-gapped Design) What happens on your trip stays on your phone. Minimo Travel Kit is built with an "air-gapped" philosophy. Your data, translations, and documents are processed and stored exclusively on your device. We do not collect, sell, or monitor your personal information.

Minimo Travel Kit Pro Pricing & Terms: Minimo Travel Kit offers a free trial with limited usages for its premium tools. To unlock unlimited access, you can upgrade to Minimo Travel Kit Pro through a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
